title: TSA carry-on liquids 3-1-1 rule
facts: For ordinary carry-on screening, liquids, aerosols, gels, creams and pastes are generally limited to containers of 3.4 ounces or 100 milliliters or less, placed in one quart-size bag, subject to TSA rules.
Medically necessary liquids and certain infant or child nourishment can qualify for exceptions and should be declared for screening.
Larger liquids generally belong in checked baggage unless an exception applies.
TSA officers make the final checkpoint decision about whether an item is permitted.
